title: Digigrain
author: lucykowal
description: Adds a GRANULAR SRC machine (id 6): a granular playback engine. TUNE = speed (pitch and grain length), RATE = grain rate (noon off, periodic CCW, random CW), SPRD = random position (CCW) or pitch (CW), POS = grain position, RTIO = grain length as a ratio of the spawn period, ENV = window (gate to sine to decay), LEV = level. Its SRC and LFO pages are drawn by machine-pages (core 3.0), so it shares a build with the other machines made for it.
